title Camino de la Victoria - the champions' road: a determined climb in B flat major (132 bpm), a drive of kick and snare on a bass that steps up (B flat, C, D, E flat) while the tune climbs a step each time, power chords, a chromatic run to the top and a roll into the loop
tempo 132
vol 225
meter 4/4
inst drive v=255,170,140
inst lead v=255,255,225,195,180
inst hero v=255,255,240,225,210,200
inst pow arp=-12,0,7 rate=1 lvl=0.9
inst kick drum=g5 v=255,200,140 d=0,-45,-75
inst snr drum=a6 noise=25 seed=14 fall=12
l8
# --- 1-8: the road climbs a step at a time (each bar of drive, then the tune a step higher)
@drive o3 [ !kick:b-8 b-8 !snr8 b-8 ]2 |
@lead o5 b-8 b-8 c4 d4 f4 |
@drive o3 [ !kick:c8 c8 !snr8 c8 ]2 |
@lead o5 c8 c8 d4 e-4 g4 |
@drive o3 [ !kick:d8 d8 !snr8 d8 ]2 |
@lead o5 d8 d8 e-4 f4 a4 |
@drive o3 [ !kick:e-8 e-8 !snr8 e-8 ]2 |
@lead o6 e-4 d4 c4 o5 b-4 |
# --- 9-12: the summit comes in sight (power chords, a long singing line)
@pow o4 b-2 f2 |
@hero o5 f4. g8 a4 b-4 |
@pow o4 e-2 b-2 |
@hero o6 c4 d4 e-4 f4 |
# --- 13-16: the last climb (the scale to the top), a high held note, a roll
@pow o4 g2 d2 |
@lead o5 b-8 >c8 d8 e-8 f8 g8 a8 b-8< |
@hero o6 d2 d2 |
[ !snr16 ]16 |
